answer: An identity requires a 500-unit bond locked in escrow plus a nonexclusive device credential, and any account lacking funds in its haven is noncompliant. A confirmed sybil forfeits 100 percent of the bond and pays a 20-epoch exit delay before any balance releases. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per cipher above 500 units because every copy posts its own bond and independent jurors audit the knoll of attestation records.
